components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-hub-purple); color: var(--color-hub-paper); font: 600 14px/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-hub-purple-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-hub-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-hub-purple-dark); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-hub-line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-hub-paper); color: var(--color-hub-ink); font: 600 14px/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-hub-purple); color: var(--color-hub-purple); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-hub-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: var(--color-hub-ink); font: 600 14px/1.3 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 44px; margin-top: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-hub-line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-hub-paper); color: var(--color-hub-ink); font: 400 14px/1.5 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-hub-purple); outline: 3px solid var(--color-hub-yellow); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-hub-purple); color: var(--color-hub-paper); font: 600 14px/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--color-hub-purple-dark); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-hub-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ready Status
components.description: Semantic Ready state in cohort tables and detail.
components.css: .ds-status-ready { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 24px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-hub-yellow); color: var(--color-hub-ink); font: 600 12px/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-status-lamp { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; }

narrative.overview: MembershipHub is a crisp, operational workspace for administrators who move between branch records, people, and cohort rosters. Its interface is built around a stable status board: fixed columns keep branch ownership, instructor assignment, dates, roster size, and lifecycle state comparable without hiding the next action. The system favors ruled white working surfaces over floating panels. Ink headers establish the table structure, purple marks the current action and location, and yellow is reserved for Ready state.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed-column data boards with clear row ownership.
Purple for active navigation and primary actions; yellow for Ready.
Mobile layouts convert tables into stacked, tappable records.

rules.name: The State-Color Rule
rules.body: Color communicates action or cohort state. Do not use the Ready yellow as general decoration.

rules.name: The Ruled-Surface Rule
rules.body: Prefer a divider or tonal change over a floating card.

dos: Do keep branch ownership visible whenever a Super Admin views cross-branch records.
Do preserve fixed column meaning across cohort and account tables.
Do use color as a state or action signal, with Ready reserved for yellow.
Do keep mobile rows readable and operable without horizontal scrolling.
donts: Don't use frontend filtering as a substitute for backend branch authorization.
Don't mark a cohort Ready before its details, instructor, and student roster are complete.
Don't put informational sections inside nested floating cards.
Don't present local demo changes as if they were saved to Django.
